title: Crack an egg cleanly
summary: Open an egg into a bowl while keeping shell pieces out.
notes: Wash hands and surfaces after handling raw egg. Do not judge the egg safe to eat from appearance.

steps.instruction: Set a bowl on a stable surface. Tap the egg once on a flat countertop.
looks_right: one visible crack in the shell
looks_wrong: shell crushed into many small pieces
steps.done_when: The egg has one crack and is held over the bowl.

steps.instruction: Put both thumbs into the crack and gently pull the shell halves apart over the bowl.
looks_wrong: shell pieces falling into the bowl
steps.done_when: The egg is in the bowl and the main shell halves are out.

steps.instruction: Check for shell. If you see a piece, lift it out with a larger piece of shell, then wash your hands.
looks_wrong: shell fragment still in the egg
steps.done_when: No shell is visible in the bowl and hands have been washed.
